items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 92:1
items.html: For after the drop of MAD reached the eyes and nose, and from there to the Yesod and crown of Atik, the Parsa within the innards of Atik was nullified — the outer one, between AA and Atik as separate Partzufim — and the two became one Partzuf. Thus HGT of AA rose to the place of his GAR, where HGT of Atik had stood, and with them rose also the discernment of the upper thirds that are clothed in these HGT, which contain also the discernment of the Yesod of Atik; therefore his screen departed from there. However, the ARI does not wish to elaborate on Atik, as is known; therefore he abbreviates and says that it cannot bear so many lights — meaning, since the lights of NHY of AA, which are revealed Chasadim, came to this place, the place of the Yesod of Atik was clarified [as being] further up, in the HGT that had been there before, which are in GAR of AA. (p. 920, Item 89)
